positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Madgrades
positions.description: Develop and maintain Madgrades, an open-source platform for exploring UW–Madison course grade distributions. Since its launch in 2018, Madgrades has processed over 30 million searches, reached 30,000 monthly users, and served the equivalent of 58% of the student body during peak registration periods. The platform includes a Java-based PDF data extraction pipeline, a public REST API (Ruby on Rails, SQL), and an interactive web application (React).

positions.title: Software Engineer, Intern
positions.description: Backend software engineering for PerBlue's mobile video game, Disney Heroes: Battle Mode.

positions.title: Founder, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and created custom Minecraft server software, website content management and forums, public REST API, database models, and various internal libraries made open source on GitHub.

Successfully scaled website to handle 1M page views per month; game server to 100K unique players per month with 3,000 playing concurrently; database to over 100M entries.

Organized 50 volunteer staff and managed a remote team of 3 developers contributing to a codebase of more than 100k lines.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern (Summers)
positions.description:
Built "Panel", a web app available to customers that interfaces with a REST API to browse and play video, audio, and images from a media library (JavaScript, React, HTML/CSS). Panel was a major selling point of the latest version of JRiver's flagship software, Media Center 23.

Created a dynamic web frontend for "Engen", a product that allows users to control connected devices in their homes (Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS).

projects.title: Charting Library
projects.description: A charting library for Dart on the Flutter mobile framework (Android/iOS). A tool for developers who are looking to create beautiful, animated, responsive charts using a simple and intuitive API.

projects.title: Avicus Network Website
projects.description: Designed and created with Ruby on Rails, MySQL, Redis, HAML, Capistrano. Generated nearly one million page views monthly at peak.
